required_implementation_tests: Closed schema/OWNER admission: reject bot/scheduled callers, serialized proofs, unknown fields, mismatched predecessor/epoch/COUNT7/claim/Core receipt and any unregistered source.

Consumed original claim and journals: verify exact payload, descriptor/manifest/writer and original POST membership; altered or missing claim, ambiguous reservations and unauthorized namespace changes fail before values/POST.

Recovery duplicate/race tests: old claim stays consumed; changed Root clocks/source cannot create a second recovery intent; concurrent successors yield at most one create-only claim and one prospective attempt; no POST retry.

previous_checkpoint=None: require stable existing state head, both exact404 directory absences and empty path commit histories; existing/deleted paths, 403/rate limits/malformed bodies or changed head fail. Ordinary unqualified-primary and durable-history guards remain strict.

Missing old Week8 bytes: permitted only by the explicit NEW-issuance scope, marked unavailable; no requirement or assertion of invented exact old document. Recovered exact old bytes must match the committed hash if used.

No tuning/identity drift: derive method, procedure, weight and model identities from authenticated original COUNT7 plus the original empty resolved startup policy; reject changed methods, weights, eligibility/scientific/model contracts or new outcome inputs.

Prevalue current clocks: persist new choice/population before acquiring current values, with distinct new choice/capture/Root identity and true current frozen/completion clocks; reject all backdating.

All fourteen Week8 games and original cutoffs: fresh full calendar identity must match; reject elapsed/expired deadlines, dropped games or extended cutoffs; verify no protected outcome read, forecast-row read in metadata preparation, source acquisition there or NFL fit.

Packing: exact known-size member, conservative-target and existing 12 MiB inflation boundaries, compressed 8 MiB boundary, singleton counting within eight groups, 512-file/index/quota bounds, pathological compressibility, exact owned fresh-reader roundtrip and no first POST on infeasible input; preserve all failures.
Both future failure paths: a new archive interruption remains FAILED, Core/opaque status is explicit and gap metadata survives; no successful flags from Core-only restoration.

Native success only: first checkpoint with previous=None follows the NEW complete capture and independent reader/export chain, carries the failed-predecessor gap and has no fabricated old forecasts, old resolved observations or scientific qualification.

Original FAILED_CAPTURE_CANNOT_RESUME, original consumed-first-claim, unqualified-primary, schema/leakage/replay/scheduler and publication protections remain green; exact-source allowlists/pins and new create-only registration fit existing bounds.
